e.summary: **Four Findings That Dissolved**（Zenodo `10.5281/zenodo.22819791`，版本 `v1.0.1`）**是一份**把**自己**的**四**个**发现**全部**撤回**的**预注册**审计**档案****——**逐字自述**「**The study produced four apparently well-supported findings and withdrew all four.**」**。**本次实测**：**⭐ 发布日 **2026-09-17****（**窗口内）**、**类型逐字 **`software`****、**许可逐字 **`mit-license`****、**作者逐字 **`Macias Araya, Alvaro Felipe`****、**文件**逐字**为 **`amacias-afma/01_four_findings_var_audit-v1.0.1.zip`（**671,406 B）**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**跨仓储元数据聚合面**」**，**并**补上**本站**最薄的一栏之一**——**学术研究**（**实测**本轮**之前 **26** 条）**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **它**把**「**撤回**」**写成**四**条**具体**的**技术**死因**，**而**不**是**一**句**「**结果**不**稳健」**——**⭐ 逐字**：**「**One fell to a multiplicity correction, one to a power analysis, one to a check of the model’s own seed noise, and one, replicated across four runs with a dose–response relationship and a sign test at p = 5.2e-04, to a scale-matched permutation control**」**——**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**最值得**学**：**⭐ 即**四个**发现**死**在**四**种**不同**的**机制**上**（**多重**比较、**功效**不足、**随机**种子**噪声、**对照**组**不**匹配）**，**这**四**种**正**是**量化**作业**里**最**常见**的**假**阳性**来源**；**② **它**把**「**可**复核**」**做**成**可**执行**的**检查****——**⭐ 逐字**：**「**No reported number is typed by hand; scripts/refresh_paper_figures.py --check fails if any summary drifts from the result files it claims to summarise.**」**——**⭐ 即**论文**里**的**每**个**数**都**由**脚本**从**结果**文件**生成**，**一旦**漂移**就**报错**；**③ **只**追加**的**测试**触达**台账****（**⭐ 逐字**记录**全部 **1,959** 次**测试集**评估**）**——**⭐ 本词条认为**这**一**件**是**本条**最**稀有**的**：**⭐ 即**它**把**「**我**看**了**多少**次**测试集」**记**成**账**，**这**正**是**判断**「**有没有**反复**调**到**过**拟合」**所**需要**的**证据**（**⭐ 而**多数**论文**只**报**最终**指标**）**；**④ **冻结**快照**带 **sha256** 清单**——**⭐ 即**数据**本身**也**可**核对**。**⚠️ 本次**未下载**其 **zip**、**未**重跑**其 **115** 个**测试**。
e.body:
**Four Findings That Dissolved**（Zenodo `10.5281/zenodo.22819791`，版本 `v1.0.1`）**是一份**把**自己**的**四**个**发现**全部**撤回**的**预注册**审计**档案****——**逐字自述**为**「**The study produced four apparently well-supported findings and withdrew all four.**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**跨仓储元数据聚合面**」**。
**可核实信息（均 2026-09-20 Zenodo 与 GitHub 接口实测）**：
**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它**把**「**撤回**」**写**成**四**条**具体**的**技术**死因**，**而**不**是**一**句**「**结果**不**稳健」****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**描述**逐字**写**「**One fell to a multiplicity correction, one to a power analysis, one to a check of the model’s own seed noise, and one — replicated across four runs with a dose–response relationship and a sign test at p = 5.2e-04 — to a scale-matched permutation control costing 28 minutes of validation compute.**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**对 **RIAA** 最有用**：**⭐ 即**四**个**发现**死**在**四**种**不同**机制**上**——**多重**比较**校正**、**功效**分析**、**随机**种子**噪声**、**置换**对照**规模**不**匹配**——**⭐ 而**这**四**种**正**是**学生**作业**里**最**容易**出现**的**假**阳性**来源**；**⭐ 更**值得**注意**的**是**其中**一**个**发现**曾**被**「**四**次**重跑**＋**剂量**反应**＋**符号**检验 **p = 5.2e-04」**三**重**支持**，**仍**然**被**一个**置换**对照**推翻**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**「**我**重跑**了**四**遍**结果**一致**」**不**足以**当**证据**，**要**问**「**对照**组**是否**同**规模**」。
**⭐⭐ ② 它**把**「**可**复核**」**做**成**可**执行**的**检查****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**描述**逐字**写**「**This archive contains everything needed to check that claim independently: the frozen ten-year price snapshots with sha256 manifests, the append-only test-touch ledger recording all 1,959 test-set evaluations, the analysis code, 115 tests, and the scripts that regenerate every figure and every number quoted in the paper. No reported number is typed by hand; scripts/refresh_paper_figures.py --check fails if any summary drifts from the result files it claims to summarise.**」**；**⭐ 本词条**据此**指出**：**⭐ 即**「**不**手**打**数字」**这**条**纪律**被**写**成**了**一个**会**失败**的**脚本**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**做**报告**或**论文**时**，**把**关键**数字**由**脚本**从**结果**文件**生成**，**并**留**一个 **`--check`** 入口**，**比**在**方法**章节**写**「**结果**可**复现」**有**说服**力**。
**⭐⭐ ③ 只**追加**的**测试**触达**台账**，**记录**全部 **1,959** 次**测试集**评估**——**⭐ 本次实测**：**描述**逐字**含 **`the append-only test-touch ledger recording all 1,959 test-set evaluations`****；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一件**是**本条**最**稀有**的**：**⭐ 即**多数**论文**只**报**最终**指标**，**而**「**测试集**被**看**了**多少**次」**才**是**判断**是否**反**复**调**到**过**拟合**的**直接**证据**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**建立**「**测试集**只**看**一次**、**每**次**都**记**账」**的**习惯**，**在**数据**竞赛**与**模型**作业**里**都**适用**（**⭐ 本词条**未**读**该**台账**内容**）**。
**⭐⭐ ④ 冻结**快照**带 **sha256** 清单**，**且**描述**明确**研究**问题**——**⭐ 本次实测**：**描述**逐字**写**「**a pre-registered study of whether anchoring a quantile-loss neural network to a classical Value-at-Risk prior improves one-day-ahead forecasts**」**，**并**逐字**说明**交付**含 **`the frozen ten-year price snapshots with sha256 manifests`****；**⭐ 本词条**据此**指出**：**⭐ 即**「**预注册**＋**冻结**快照**＋**哈希**清单」**三**件**合**起来**，**才**让**「**我**没**改**过**假设」**成为**可**核对**的**陈述**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**VaR** 是**风控**与**精算**都**会**用**到**的**概念**，**而**这**份**档案**示范**了**如何**把**一**个 **VaR** 改进**主张**审**到**底**。
**⭐⭐ ⑤ 元数据**与**窗口****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**发布日 **2026-09-17****（**窗口内）**、**类型逐字 **`software`****、**许可逐字 **`mit-license`****、**版本逐字 **`v1.0.1`****、**文件**逐字 **`amacias-afma/01_four_findings_var_audit-v1.0.1.zip`（**671,406 B）**、**作者逐字 **`Macias Araya, Alvaro Felipe`****、**相关**标识**逐字 **`isSupplementTo` 指向 **GitHub** 的 **`github.com/amacias-afma/01_four_findings_var_audit/tree/v1.0.1`****；**⭐ 而 **GitHub** 侧**逐字**为 **★0、**许可**字段 **`NOASSERTION`（**GitHub** 未**识别**出**标准**许可**）、**主**语言 **Python、**仓库 **3,918 KB、**创建 **2026-08-19、**末次**推送 **2026-09-18、**描述**为 **null****——**⭐ 本词条**如实**指出**：**⭐ 即**Zenodo** 侧**写 **MIT**，**而 **GitHub** 侧**未**能**识别**许可**，**两**处**不一致**时**以**仓库**内**实际**许可**文件**为**准**（**⭐ 本词条**未**读**该**文件**）**。
**⭐⭐ ⑥ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[reproducible-actuarial-work]] 覆盖**精算**可**复现**工作**、**[[finproof-bench]] 覆盖**金融**AI** 护栏**对抗**基准**、**[[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]] 覆盖**保险 **AI** 可靠性**基准**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**研究**者**对**自己**的**结论**做**预注册**审计**并**全部**撤回**」这一**形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。
**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **撤回**要**写**具体**机制**，**不**写**「**不**稳健」**；**② **把**「**不**手**打**数字」**写**成**会**失败**的**检查**；**③ **测试集**触达**要**记**账**；**④ **预注册**＋**冻结**快照**＋**哈希**清单**三者**缺**一不可**；**⑤ **重**跑**多**次**一致**不**等于**结论**成立**，**对照**组**同**规模**才**关键**。
**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有下载**其 **zip**（**671,406 B）**、**未**运行**其 **115** 个**测试**、**未**重跑**其**任何**实验**，**故**不**主张**其**可**复现**性**、**测试**有效性**或**结论**正确性**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**Zenodo** 与 **GitHub** 接口返回的**元数据与描述**，**未读**其**代码**、**台账**、**清单**或**论文**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其**「**1,959** 次**测试集**评估」**与**「**115** 个**测试」**的**实际**数字**（**只**按**其**自述**记录）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**预注册**记录**是否**在**实验前**完成**（**⭐ 只**见**其**自述**含**预注册**记录）**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其 **sha256** 清单**是否**与**冻结**快照**一致**。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核实**其 **GitHub** 侧**许可**（**接口**为 **`NOASSERTION`**）**与 **Zenodo** 侧 **MIT** 的**差异**原因**。**⑦ ⚠️ 窗口**状况**：**发布日 **2026-09-17** 在**本轮**窗口**之内**（**基准日 **2026-09-20）**，**故**无需**缺口**说明**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-20 所见**；**⚠️ 涉及**模型**审计**与 **VaR** 预测**，**⚠️ 其**结论**不**构成**任何**投资**或**风险**管理**建议**。

e.summary_en: This is a pre-registration audit archive whose own study produced four apparently well-supported findings and withdrew all four. **Measured this round**: published on the seventeenth of September inside the window, typed as software, MIT licensed, credited to one author, and shipped as a single archive of about two thirds of a megabyte. **This entry belongs to the round theme of cross-repository metadata aggregators and fills one of the thinnest categories on the site, academic research, which held twenty-six entries before this round.** **Four things are worth reading: it writes the withdrawal as four concrete technical causes rather than one sentence about robustness, with one finding falling to a multiplicity correction, one to a power analysis, one to a check of the model own seed noise, and one to a scale-matched permutation control, so the four mechanisms are exactly the commonest sources of false positives in quantitative work; it makes checkability executable, stating that no reported number is typed by hand and that a script fails if any summary drifts from the result files it claims to summarise, so every number in the paper is generated from results rather than transcribed; it keeps an append-only ledgers of test touches recording every test-set evaluation, which is the rarest item here and precisely the evidence needed to judge whether a model was repeatedly tuned against its test set, where most papers report only final metrics; and its frozen snapshots carry hash manifests, so the data can be checked too.** **No archive was downloaded and the test suite was not rerun this round.**
e.summary_hk: **Four Findings That Dissolved**（Zenodo `10.5281/zenodo.22819791`，版本 `v1.0.1`）**是一份**把**自己**的四個發現**全部**撤回**的**預註冊**審計**檔案****——**逐字自述**「**The study produced four apparently well-supported findings and withdrew all four.**」**。**本次實測**：**⭐ 發布日 2026-09-17（**窗口內**）**、**類型逐字 `software`**、**許可逐字 `mit-license`**、**作者逐字 `Macias Araya, Alvaro Felipe`**、**文件逐字為 `amacias-afma/01_four_findings_var_audit-v1.0.1.zip`（**671,406 B）**。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**跨倉儲元資料聚合面**」**，**並補上本站最薄的一欄之一**——**學術研究**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四處最值得看**：**① **把撤回寫成四條具體技術死因**（**逐字**One fell to a multiplicity correction, one to a power analysis, one to a check of the model’s own seed noise, and one, replicated across four runs with a dose–response relationship and a sign test at p = 5.2e-04, to a scale-matched permutation control**）——**⭐ 即**四種假陽性來源**：**多重比較、**功效不足、**種子噪聲、**對照不匹配**；**② **把可複核做成可執行的檢查**（**逐字**No reported number is typed by hand; scripts/refresh_paper_figures.py --check fails if any summary drifts from the result files it claims to summarise.**）**；**③ **只追加的測試觸達台賬**（**逐字記錄全部 1,959 次測試集評估**）——**⭐ 即**判斷有沒有反覆調到過擬合所需的證據**；**④ **凍結快照帶 sha256 清單**。**⚠️ 本次**未下載其 zip、**未重跑其 115 個測試**。
e.body_en:
This is a pre-registration audit archive whose own study produced four apparently well-supported findings and withdrew all four. **This entry belongs to the round theme of cross-repository metadata aggregators.**
**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-20 from the Zenodo and repository interfaces**:
**First, it writes the withdrawal as four concrete technical causes rather than one sentence about robustness.** The description records that one finding fell to a multiplicity correction, one to a power analysis, one to a check of the model own seed noise, and one, which had been replicated across four runs with a dose-response relationship and a sign test at a small p-value, to a scale-matched permutation control costing a stated amount of validation compute. **Those four mechanisms are precisely the commonest sources of false positives in quantitative work, and it is worth noticing that one finding carried three forms of support, including repeated runs, and was still overturned by a permutation control, so repeatability across runs is not sufficient evidence and the question to ask is whether the control group is matched in scale.**
**Second, it makes checkability executable.** The description states that the archive contains everything needed to check the claim independently, listing frozen ten-year price snapshots with hash manifests, an append-only test-touch ledger recording every test-set evaluation, analysis code, a stated number of tests, and scripts that regenerate every figure and every number quoted in the paper, and it states that no reported number is typed by hand and that a script fails if any summary drifts from the result files it claims to summarise. **Writing the discipline of not typing numbers by hand as a script that fails is more persuasive than asserting reproducibility in a methods section, and generating key figures from result files with a check entry point is a practice worth copying for reports as well as papers.**
**Third, the append-only test-touch ledger records every test-set evaluation, which is the rarest item here.** Most papers report only final metrics, while how many times a test set was consulted is the direct evidence for judging whether a model was repeatedly tuned against it. **Recording every touch, and treating the test set as something looked at once and logged, transfers to both competitions and modelling coursework. The ledger contents were not read this round.**
**Fourth, frozen snapshots carry hash manifests and the description states the research question explicitly.** The study asks whether anchoring a quantile-loss neural network to a classical Value-at-Risk prior improves one-day-ahead forecasts. **Pre-registration, frozen snapshots, and hash manifests together are what turn the claim of not having changed the hypothesis into something checkable, and since value at risk appears in both risk control and actuarial work, this archive demonstrates how to audit an improvement claim of that kind to the end.**
**Fifth, metadata and window status.** Published on the seventeenth of September inside the window, typed as software, MIT licensed at a patch version, shipped as an archive of about two thirds of a megabyte, credited to one author, and linked by a supplement relation to a matching tag on a source repository. **The repository side shows no stars, a licence field that the hosting platform could not identify as a standard licence, one language, a repository of about four megabytes, creation in August, a push inside the window, and no description, so when the two sides disagree about licensing the actual licence file in the repository governs, and that file was not read here.**
**Sixth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover reproducible actuarial work, a guardrail adversarial benchmark for financial AI, and an insurance AI reliability benchmark, **while this entry supplies the form of a researcher auditing their own conclusions under pre-registration and withdrawing all of them. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**
**For RIAA**: **five practices transfer: write withdrawals as concrete mechanisms rather than as a robustness caveat; make the no-hand-typed-numbers rule an executable check; log every test-set touch; combine pre-registration, frozen snapshots, and hash manifests; and remember that repeated runs agreeing does not establish a finding if the control is not scale-matched.**
**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no archive was downloaded, the test suite was not run, and no experiment was rerun**, so no claim is made about reproducibility, test validity, or the correctness of its conclusions. **Second, only metadata and description were read**, not the code, the ledger, the manifests, or the manuscript. **Third, the two stated counts were not verified. Fourth, whether the pre-registration record predates the experiments was not verified. Fifth, whether the hash manifests match the frozen snapshots was not verified. Sixth, the reason for the licensing discrepancy between the two sides was not verified. Seventh, the publication date falls inside this round window against a baseline of the twentieth of September. Eighth, this entry records what was visible on that date and states plainly that its conclusions constitute no investment or risk-management advice.**

**Four Findings That Dissolved**（Zenodo `10.5281/zenodo.22819791`，版本 `v1.0.1`）**是一份**把**自己**的四個發現**全部**撤回**的**預註冊**審計**檔案****——**逐字自述**為**「**The study produced four apparently well-supported findings and withdrew all four.**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**跨倉儲元資料聚合面**」**。
**可核實資訊（均 2026-09-20 Zenodo 與 GitHub 介面實測）**：
**⭐⭐⭐ ① 把撤回寫成四條具體技術死因**——**逐字**One fell to a multiplicity correction, one to a power analysis, one to a check of the model’s own seed noise, and one — replicated across four runs with a dose–response relationship and a sign test at p = 5.2e-04 — to a scale-matched permutation control costing 28 minutes of validation compute.**；**⭐ 即**多重比較、**功效不足、**種子噪聲、**置換對照規模不匹配是四種假陽性來源**；**⭐ 更值得注意**：**其中一個發現曾被四次重跑＋**劑量反應＋**符號檢驗 p = 5.2e-04 三重支持**，**仍被置換對照推翻**——**⭐ 即**重跑多次一致不等於結論成立**，**要問對照組是否同規模**。
**⭐⭐ ② 把可複核做成可執行的檢查**——**逐字**No reported number is typed by hand; scripts/refresh_paper_figures.py --check fails if any summary drifts from the result files it claims to summarise.**；**⭐ 即**不手打數字被寫成一個會失敗的腳本**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 元數據與窗口**——**發布日 2026-09-17**、**類型 `software`**、**許可 `mit-license`**、**版本 `v1.0.1`**、**文件 `amacias-afma/01_four_findings_var_audit-v1.0.1.zip`（671,406 B）**、**作者 `Macias Araya, Alvaro Felipe`**；**GitHub 側逐字為 ★0、**許可字段 `NOASSERTION`、**Python、**3,918 KB、**創建 2026-08-19、**末次推送 2026-09-18、**描述 null**——**⭐ 即**兩處許可描述不一致時以倉庫內實際許可文件為準**。
